A GOAL THAT FITS YOU
Answer a few quick questions and Protein Pal calculates a daily protein goal whether you want to lose fat or maintain or build muscle. You can adjust it any time, or set a different goal for a specific day.

BUILT FOR GLP-1 USERS
Taking a GLP-1 medication? Protein Pal can set a GLP-1 friendly goal. Eating enough protein while your appetite is lower helps preserve lean muscle as you lose weight, and Protein Pal makes it easy to see whether you're getting enough each day.

LOG FOOD YOUR WAY
- AI photo scan: snap a photo of your meal and get an estimate for each ingredient, then edit anything before you log it
- Barcode scanning for packaged foods (where available)
- Search a large food database (where available)
- Quick add when you just know the numbers
- Save favorites and meals you eat often, and organize entries by meal type

TRACK MORE THAN PROTEIN
Protein always comes first, but you can also track calories, fiber, carbs and fat. Set each goal as a daily minimum or a limit.

STAY ON TRACK
- Daily reminders plus an evening summary of how close you are to your goal
- Streaks for every day you hit your goal, with a streak goal to aim for
- Home and lock screen widgets
- Apple Health sync

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Stats show your average daily intake, your intake against your target by day or month, and your most eaten foods. Meal insights show your protein density (protein per 100 calories) and how each meal compares with your recent history. Export your entries to CSV any time.

PROTEIN PAL PRO
- AI photo scan, plus barcode scanning and food database search where available
- Unlimited favorites, meals and custom reminders
- Complete tracking history and stats
- Widgets

IN-APP PURCHASE REQUIRED: Protein Tracker is free to download. Most people underestimate how much protein they eat in a day. That gap can slow progress, recovery, and energy.

The fix is simple - know what you're eating. Protein Tracker makes that easy.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set your daily protein target from your body weight and goal, or type in your own number.
2. Add what you ate: search the food collection, snap a photo of the meal, scan a barcode, say it out loud, or enter a custom food.
3. Check the portion and the protein amount, adjust anything that looks off, then save.
4. Watch the progress ring fill, and use the weekly calendar to see how each day compares with your target.

WHAT PROTEIN TRACKER PRO INCLUDES (separate purchase)

- Logging food to any of the last seven days, with an editable time on every entry
- A searchable collection of high-protein foods, with common portions or a custom amount
- Photo, barcode, and voice logging with AI, and every result stays editable before you save
- Favorites and recent custom portions for the foods you eat often
- Daily history, trends over time, streaks, achievements, and challenges
- Goal and unit settings you can change whenever your training does

DATA AND AI

No account, no sign-up, no ads. Your protein log is stored on your device. Photo, barcode, and voice logging send that input for AI processing and need an internet connection - typing and searching stay on your device. AI estimates are approximations, so review them before saving. Protein Tracker is a tracking tool, not medical or dietary advice.

That's it. A minute to set up, and you'll finally know exactly where your protein stands - every single day.

results.description:
If you are anything like me, eating on a ketogenic or low carb diet means I'm not scanning the barcodes of processed foods very often.  Instead, I'm making and eating a limited number of fresh and healthy meals/snacks on a repeat basis.

I made this app because I just wanted a simple way to quickly input my own custom foods (an area that is severely lacking in other free apps).  And I wanted to be able to re-use those foods as they were or to modify the "serving" amount.  

Instead of wondering whether this is a small, medium or large apple/tomato/etc., I can add the nutrition of a tomato at 100 grams.  Then I weigh a tomato of any size, select my previously input tomato, and change the serving size to match the weight of this tomato.  The macro / calorie information updates automatically.

I hope you find this app helpful in achieving your goals!

Not enough protein at lunch? Too many carbs by dinner? See protein, carbs, and fats for every meal and balance your diet as you go.

BUILD A MEAL, A FEW TAPS AT A TIME
Search more than 13,000 offline food records, with everyday choices first. Add lentils by the cup, yogurt by the pot, or any food by weight in grams or ounces. See protein and fiber for the whole meal as you build it.

MAKE NEXT TIME EASIER
Recent foods remember your last amounts. Save favorite meals, repeat them in half, one or one-and-a-half servings, and divide batch recipes into portions.

COPY YOUR OWN LABEL
Enter protein and fiber from a packet per serving or per 100 g. A value that is not on the label stays unknown; it is never silently turned into zero.

YOUR WEEK AT A GLANCE
See what you recorded each day against your goals, correct a meal without duplicating it, and keep every entry on your phone.

GOALS FROM PUBLISHED REFERENCES
Set your own daily goals, or let Spoonlet suggest them from cited references: protein from your body weight (0.8, 1.2 or 1.6 g per kg) and fiber from EFSA, WHO or US adequate intakes. Every suggestion shows its source. Your weight is used only for the calculation and never stored.

GENEROUSLY FREE
Everyday logging, food search, label foods, favorite meals, batch portions, diary history, weekly summaries, export and restore are free. Your first eligible detailed weekly review is free to keep.

OPTIONAL SPOONLET PLUS
Plus is built around the two nutrients. Close the gap: a menu of familiar portions that would finish today's protein or fiber, each one tap from a new meal. See what carries your week: the top foods and meals behind each number, goal streaks, and 30, 90 and 365-day trends. Share a PDF review with a coach or doctor. Meal folders, tags and covers plus extra themes are included. Choose an annual subscription or a one-time lifetime unlock; prices are shown by your store in your local currency. Annual subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your store account.

WHY PROTEIN AND FIBER
Only about 5% of US adults reach the fiber reference intake, and average intake is around 15 to 17 g a day against a reference of 25 to 38 g. Higher fiber intake is associated with lower rates of heart disease, type 2 diabetes and colorectal cancer in large reviews. Up to 46% of adults over 70 do not meet the protein reference intake, and protein supports muscle at every age. Spoonlet shows both nutrients side by side so the gap is easy to see and easy to close.

YOUR DIARY STAYS IN YOUR HANDS
Food logging works offline. Spoonlet does not upload your diary and excludes it from automatic device backups. Export a backup before changing phones. Purchases use your app store and RevenueCat; your meal contents are not sent to RevenueCat.

Food values and household portions are estimates based on their stated sources or your own labels. Associations reported in nutrition research are not proof of cause. Spoonlet records food and provides general information; it does not diagnose, treat or give individualized dietary advice.

results.description:
Nutrician is a nutrition coach that tells you where its numbers come from. Describe a meal in chat or photograph it, and you get calories and macros back in seconds. No database to search, no forms to fill in.

Building muscle, eating better, or finding food hard right now — the job is the same. Know what you actually ate, and whether you got enough protein.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

Every number tells you where it came from.

Most food apps show a calorie count and leave you to assume it is right. Nutrician shows the source of each figure: read off a label, matched to a database, taken from a restaurant's published data, corrected by you, or estimated from a photo. An estimate is labelled an estimate and carries a range. Where the app cannot work something out it says so, rather than choosing a number that looks plausible.

The app is also structurally unable to invent a number. The AI writes the sentence; the figures are filled in afterward from what you logged, and anything it states on its own is stripped before it reaches you.

YOUR DAY, AT A GLANCE

Home is a dashboard, not a chat log: protein, carbs and fat as dials you can read in a second, calories and water beside them, today's meals underneath. The conversation is one tap away.

A new account starts from published daily values rather than empty rings, and hands over to your own the moment you set them.

BUILT AROUND YOUR GOAL

Tell it what you are working toward and the framing follows: building muscle means protein is what you build with, holding steady means protein is what you hold on to. 

-Protein is a floor to reach, not a ceiling to stay under
-Calories are a floor too, and the app never warns you for eating too little
-No shame copy, no streak guilt, nothing sold back to you for a missed day

IF YOU ARE ON A GLP-1

Appetite is suppressed, portions are small, and protein matters most. Nutrician treats that as normal, not as a failure.

-A low-calorie day on the medication is not a failure, and the app never says it is
-Ate half of it? Say so and the numbers rescale, or photograph the plate and it works out what is left
-Shot day, side effects and appetite changes all go in the same chat box 
-Symptoms that need a clinician point you at your prescriber, not a food tip

Nutrician promotes no medication, supplies nothing, and takes no money from any prescriber or pharmacy.

APPLE HEALTH                                                                                                    

Read your weight in from Health so your trend stays current. Write your meals out so your other health apps can see them. 

WHAT ELSE IS IN IT

-Photo logging where your own words outrank what the camera guessed
-A suggestion for what to eat next, drawn from meals you have actually logged
-Correct any meal's figures directly, and your numbers become the record
-Restaurant menus matched to where you are, before you order
-Weight, water, measurements and symptoms, from the same chat box
-A plain summary you can hand to your prescriber or dietitian 
-Streaks with no dark patterns: rest days are free
-CSV export and saved meals

HONEST ABOUT THE LIMITS

Portion size is the hardest part of tracking food and no app has solved it, including this one. A database entry is an average, not a measurement of your plate. Even a nutrition label is a range: federal rules let the protein in a food run as low as 80 percent of the declared value and the calories as high as 120 percent.

We do not claim to be the most accurate app. Everybody claims that and you cannot check it. We claim something you can: every figure shows its origin, and our guesses look different from our facts.

FREE TO TRY

A seven-day trial, then a free tier you can stay on as long as you like. Precision is $9.99 a month or $99 a year.

Nutrician is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Protein targets, medication questions and symptoms belong with your prescriber.

Brink: AI Workout Planner, Fitness Tracker & Photo Calorie Counter

Brink helps you create workout plans, track gym workouts, and log meals with photo nutrition tracking, all in one simple fitness app.

Whether your goal is to build muscle, lose weight, get stronger, or stay consistent, Brink gives you a clear plan, easy workout tracking, calorie and macro estimates, and progress tools that help you keep going.

No complicated setup. No guessing what to do next. Just a smarter way to train, eat, and stay consistent.

What You Can Do With Brink
Get a Personalized Workout Plan

Tell Brink your goals, experience level, schedule, and available equipment. Brink creates a workout plan built around you, whether you train at the gym, at home, or with limited equipment.

Use Brink to build muscle, lose weight, get stronger, improve fitness, create a gym routine, or stay consistent.

Your plan can be customized as your goals, schedule, or experience level changes.

Track Your Workouts

Follow your workout and log exercises, sets, reps, weight, and workout time.

Whether you are following a strength plan, gym workout routine, or general fitness program, Brink helps you stay organized and see your progress.

Follow Exercise Walkthroughs

Not sure how to do an exercise? Brink includes exercise guidance to help you feel more confident during your workouts.

Track Food From a Photo

Logging food should not take forever.

With Brink's photo nutrition tracking, you can take a picture of your meal and get an estimate of calories, protein, carbs, and fat.

Use Brink as your calorie tracker, macro tracker, and meal tracker to support your fitness goals.

Get Macro Recommendations

Brink can recommend daily nutrition targets based on your body, workouts, and goals, whether you are trying to lose fat, build muscle, or maintain progress.

See Your Progress

View your workout history, nutrition logs, and consistency over time. Staying motivated is easier when you can see the work adding up.

Why Brink?

Brink is built for people who want fitness to feel less confusing.

You get the structure of a workout plan, the convenience of a fitness tracker, and the simplicity of photo-based nutrition tracking in one app.

Brink can help you:

Create AI workout plans
Track gym workouts
Log sets, reps, and weights
Track calories and macros
Estimate nutrition from food photos
Build muscle
Lose weight
Stay consistent
Monitor progress

Whether you are new to fitness or already train regularly, Brink helps you know what to do next.

Common Questions
Can Brink create a workout plan for me?

Yes. Brink can create a personalized workout plan based on your goals, fitness level, schedule, and available equipment.

Is Brink good for beginners?

Yes. Brink is simple enough for beginners while still being useful for people who already work out.

Can I use Brink as a gym workout tracker?

Yes. Brink lets you follow workouts, track exercises, log sets and reps, record weights, and monitor progress.

Can Brink track calories from a food photo?

Yes. Take a photo of your food and Brink helps estimate calories, protein, carbs, and fat.

Can Brink help me build muscle or lose weight?

Yes. Brink can create workout plans and nutrition targets based on goals like building muscle, losing weight, getting stronger, or improving fitness.

Can I customize my workout plan?

Yes. Brink workout plans are customizable as your schedule, equipment, or goals change.

Subscription Information

Some features require a subscription to access.

Subscriptions are available as in-app purchases and are billed through your Apple ID account.
